intro.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
intro.text: The release line is dark. Build one safe path from source to production.

success.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
success.text: Factory restored. One artifact, tested before it reaches the city.

failure.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
failure.text: That line cannot carry a safe release. Inspect the order and the wiring.

engineerMode.artifact:
name: release
on: [push]
jobs:
  build:
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build
      - run: ./deploy.sh

annotation.text: A real pipeline starts from checked-out source.
Tests are a gate before packaging and deployment.
